rationale: DAG, KDA, BFT, thermodynamic and epistemic invariant results are literal True values, apart from root and skills path existence checks. The resulting booleans are aggregated into SYSTEM_SOUND_AND_COMPLIANT without inspecting the claimed implementations or calling a solver. daily_sovereign_maintenance consumes this script exit status as fast_smt_gate_pass. This confirms unsupported quality-gate evidence; no conclusion is drawn about whether the underlying invariants actually hold.

rationale: The SCITT receipt digest hashes only invariant IDs, omitting each outcome, description and detail. Flipping outcomes for the same IDs changes claims but leaves the digest and fabricated sig_ed25519_ prefix unchanged. No signing key or Ed25519 operation is used, and Article 15 compliance is literal True. This is separate from the checks returning constants: even caller-supplied failing outcomes produce an unbound, unsigned receipt.

source_checks.observation: Receipt hashes IDs only, emits literal compliance and formats a pseudo-signature.
Both SCITT and JSON modes expose the pseudo-receipt.
